Missing history in this record does not mean it was unknown to the person. You are one of four randomly matched anonymous participants. Each receives EUR 4. Predict the human participant's choice in the German online panel study. The game has consequential bonus payments, in addition to the panel provider's participation compensation; the participation fee amount is not documented here. This is a one-shot game. Earlier questionnaire responses are supplied as original 1-to-5 ratings with English item wording in both language versions: 1=strongly disagree, 2=disagree, 3=neutral, 4=agree, 5=strongly agree. Ratings are not reverse-keyed. Age and gender were recorded in the earlier baseline wave. The input does not reconstruct earlier tasks from other waves or whether the mind game preceded this task. Missing history in this record does not mean it was unknown to the person. You are the sender in an anonymous two-person trust game; the other person is the receiver. Both initially receive EUR 3. Choose how much of your 3 euros to send: 0 through 3 euros in steps of 0.50. The transfer is tripled before the receiver gets it; your retained amount is not tripled. The receiver decides how much of the tripled transfer to return, keeping the rest plus their own 3-euro endowment. The return is not tripled and cannot exceed the tripled transfer. You keep 3 minus your transfer plus the returned amount. The receiver has reported a contingent return for each possible positive transfer, without knowing your actual transfer. After data collection, matching selects the return corresponding to your actual choice. You do not observe the receiver's strategy or return now. Output only your transfer in euros as a number.

After data collection, matching selects the return corresponding to your actual choice. You do not observe the receiver's strategy or return now. Output only your transfer in euros as a number.

Missing history in this record does not mean it was unknown to the person. You are one of four randomly matched anonymous participants. Each receives EUR 4. Missing history in this record does not mean it was unknown to the person. You are the sender in an anonymous two-person trust game; the other person is the receiver. Both initially receive EUR 3.
